core.headline: Two-bedroom mid-terrace house, Dartford DA1
core.listing:
A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Dartford DA1 for sale by Shared Ownership. The price is £130,000 for a 40% share. Rent on the unsold share is £487 per month. The full market value is £325,000. The tenure is leasehold with 990 years remaining, peppercorn ground rent and a service charge of £312 per year (2026/27 estimate).

The accommodation comprises a reception room, a kitchen, and a bathroom on the ground floor. There are two bedrooms on the first floor.

Outside there is a rear garden. Parking is provided by a driveway with two spaces.

Dartford town centre is nearby.

The price is £130,000 for a 40% share. Rent on the unsold share is £487 per month. The full market value is £325,000. The tenure is leasehold with 990 years remaining, peppercorn ground rent and a service charge of £312 per year (2026/27 estimate). Council Tax is Band C (Dartford Borough Council). The EPC rating is B. Construction is standard. Electricity is mains. Water is mains and metered. Sewerage is mains. Heating is gas central heating. Broadband is FTTC. Mobile signal is good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking is driveway. Shared ownership eligibility criteria apply. The housing association has an 8-week nomination period on resale.
